g.style: fill:#000000; fill-opacity:1.0000;stroke:#000000; stroke-opacity:1.0000; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round;

g.text: Title: TPA3126D2 - stereo BTL / C21 bypass

g.desc: Title: TPA3126D2 - stereo BTL / C21 bypass

g.style: fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;
fill:#FFFFC2; fill-opacity:1.0000; stroke:none;

g.text: Post-filter branches to GND; check resistor heating on bench.

g.desc: Post-filter branches to GND; check resistor heating on bench.

g.text: Route source-side input reference returns to the DAC GND.

g.desc: Route source-side input reference returns to the DAC GND.

g.text: Power loops must not share those return traces.

g.desc: Power loops must not share those return traces.

g.text: 20 dB MASTER; AM[2:0]=000 -> 400 kHz nominal. MODSEL=0 -> hybrid mode.

g.desc: 20 dB MASTER; AM[2:0]=000 -> 400 kHz nominal. MODSEL=0 -> hybrid mode.

g.text: Each CSAD package: winding 1-2, winding 4-3. No assumed flux cancellation.

g.desc: Each CSAD package: winding 1-2, winding 4-3. No assumed flux cancellation.

g.text: TI Fig.31 filter: 10u per leg + 680n to GND per leg (four film capacitors total).

g.desc: TI Fig.31 filter: 10u per leg + 680n to GND per leg (four film capacitors total).

g.text: ATS-TI1OP-521-C1-R1 over U1; fit checked by user. Top PowerPAD, no PCB EP copper.

g.desc: ATS-TI1OP-521-C1-R1 over U1; fit checked by user. Top PowerPAD, no PCB EP copper.

g.text: Top pad may be grounded (preferred) or floating per TI; never connect it to PVDD.

g.desc: Top pad may be grounded (preferred) or floating per TI; never connect it to PVDD.

g.text: ONBOARD TWEETER CAPACITOR / JP1 STEREO BYPASS

g.desc: ONBOARD TWEETER CAPACITOR / JP1 STEREO BYPASS

g.text: C21 = Nichicon UES1H470MPM, 47u / 50V bipolar, 10 x 20 mm.

g.desc: C21 = Nichicon UES1H470MPM, 47u / 50V bipolar, 10 x 20 mm.

g.text: Onboard in series with filtered tweeter positive -> J17 pin 1.

g.desc: Onboard in series with filtered tweeter positive -> J17 pin 1.

g.text: JP1 OPEN: capacitor active; JP1 LINKED: bypass for stereo use.

g.desc: JP1 OPEN: capacitor active; JP1 LINKED: bypass for stereo use.

g.text: Use a short insulated wire link rated >=3 A; change only with power off.

g.desc: Use a short insulated wire link rated >=3 A; change only with power off.

g.text: Neither speaker terminal is ground. Without cap or link, output is open.

g.desc: Neither speaker terminal is ground. Without cap or link, output is open.

g.text: Nominal 4 ohm pole ~847 Hz; actual response follows tweeter impedance.

g.desc: Nominal 4 ohm pole ~847 Hz; actual response follows tweeter impedance.

g.text: Account for capacitor phase/response in the DSP crossover.

g.desc: Account for capacitor phase/response in the DSP crossover.

g.text: Heatsink and C21 fit checked by user (23 Oct 2026); bench thermal test remains.

g.desc: Heatsink and C21 fit checked by user (23 Oct 2026); bench thermal test remains.

g.text: WOOFER / J16: DAC RIGHT -> AMPLIFIER RIGHT BRIDGE

g.desc: WOOFER / J16: DAC RIGHT -> AMPLIFIER RIGHT BRIDGE

g.text: SDZ default LOW; MUTE default HIGH. 10k/100n command filtering

g.desc: SDZ default LOW; MUTE default HIGH. 10k/100n command filtering

g.text: limits slew below TI 10 V/ms. SDZ asserted low is the primary safe state.

g.desc: limits slew below TI 10 V/ms. SDZ asserted low is the primary safe state.

g.text: MUTE command HIGH=mute, LOW=play. Wait >=50 ms after SDZ high

g.desc: MUTE command HIGH=mute, LOW=play. Wait >=50 ms after SDZ high

g.text: before unmuting. FAULTZ open-drain -> GPIO35, 100k pull-up.

g.desc: before unmuting. FAULTZ open-drain -> GPIO35, 100k pull-up.

g.text: No automatic retry link: log fault, mute, cycle SDZ only after diagnosis.

g.desc: No automatic retry link: log fault, mute, cycle SDZ only after diagnosis.

g.text: TWEETER / J17: DAC LEFT -> AMPLIFIER LEFT BRIDGE

g.desc: TWEETER / J17: DAC LEFT -> AMPLIFIER LEFT BRIDGE

g.text: PLIMIT: 3V3-ESP -> R19 10k / C29 1u RC; no lower divider resistor.

g.desc: PLIMIT: 3V3-ESP -> R19 10k / C29 1u RC; no lower divider resistor.

g.text: TI peak-rail model ~19W unclipped / 4 ohm nominal.

g.desc: TI peak-rail model ~19W unclipped / 4 ohm nominal.

g.text: Headroom for 15W; not an exact 15W protection limit.

g.desc: Headroom for 15W; not an exact 15W protection limit.

g.text: Power derates below 16V; measure clipping / thermals.

g.desc: Power derates below 16V; measure clipping / thermals.
